decisions.reason: The oncology risk management software builds on the established offer, has kept its own page since 2023 and supports the announced convergence of machine and patient QA, so slow uptake would still be read as a temporary adoption lag.
The CT image quality phantom is a recent launch close to the core imaging QA offer, so there is too little evidence of failure to justify withdrawal.

The mammography image quality phantom is distant from the core and carries less investment and justification pressure, but it was only launched in 2024 and has its own page, so disappointing results would still be attributed to early-market causes.

The full field mammography phantom is also distant from the core and partly overlaps Product D, which makes it the likeliest candidate for consolidation, yet one year is too short to abandon the imaging expansion.
The multi-model imaging QA line is publicly presented as a flagship of the firm's direction and represents a large investment, so management will strongly persist with it.
